title: ToolBinding
description: Who may use a tool. Owned by NexChat (nexus://tool/binding/<id>) and attached to exactly one scope — an Agent, a Project or a Flow. A binding never widens a ToolDefinition: `constraints` narrow inputs/classification and `approval` may only tighten. Runtime permission is the intersection UserPermission ∩ ProjectPermission ∩ AgentToolGrant ∩ ToolPolicy ∩ DataClassificationPolicy ∩ DeploymentPolicy — the binding is only one factor.

connection_id.description: Required for kind=integration|custom tools; absent for platform tools.

scope.description: Exactly one of agent_id | project_id | flow_id.

operations.description: Subset of a collection's tools/operations granted ("3 of 7 tools"). Absent = the whole definition.

input_allow.description: JSON Schema subset the inputs must additionally satisfy (e.g. supplier_id pattern).

max_classification.description: May only be ≤ the definition's classification_max.

approval.description: May only tighten the definition's mode (none → policy → always).

granted_by.description: Human actor (Project owner / agent author). Agents never bind capabilities — only governed CapabilityRequests do.

capability_request_ref.description: Set when the binding was created by approving a CapabilityRequest.
